name: B League
description: A competitive slow-pitch league with paid umpires, standard field dimensions, and a male:female ratio of 8:2. Runs three seasons a year: spring, summer, and fall.
standingsNote: Standings update automatically as scores are reported.
ruleHighlights: Slow-pitch, co-ed. A team consists of 10 players, at least 2 of whom are women; games may be played short-handed with 8 rostered players (at least 1 female) without forfeit.
Games are 7 innings or a 1-hour-10-minute time limit, whichever comes first. A tied game at the time/innings limit ends in a tie (except during tournament play).
Mercy rule: game ends after 5 innings if a team is ahead by 15+ runs and has completed its at-bat.
No base stealing. No bunting or deliberate chop hits.
All players must have a signed waiver on file before taking the field.

name: C League
description: A non-competitive, more relaxed league — no balls and strikes, batting team supplies the umpire, home team sets up the field. Male:female ratio of 7:3. One ~18-week season from mid-April to Labor Day.
standingsNote: C League does not track official standings centrally — it's a non-competitive league focused on participation. Check with your team manager for game results.
ruleHighlights: Non-competitive, no called balls and strikes.
Male:female ratio of 7:3. The batting team supplies the umpire; the home team sets up the field and is responsible for equipment.
Games run Monday through Wednesday at Hahamongna Park, ~18-week season from mid-April to Labor Day.
The only official reporting requirement is forfeits (fewer than 8 players, or no women present).
